text: “纳-德尔-曼！纳-德尔-曼！”凛冽的风在你耳边低语。随着这声音而来的，是奔向源头的冲动，仿佛只要触碰冬日的天空便能得到满足。你迫切地想抵达那里，与天上的某物融为一体。这召唤向你许诺一种超越生命的存在、一种战胜死亡的死亡，以及一种凌驾于不朽之上的变化。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 264
text: Na-del-mann! Na-del-mann! The raw wind whispers in your ears. With the sound comes a compulsion to run toward its source, to somehow touch the wintry sky. You desperately want to reach—to merge—with whatever is up there. In the summons is an offer: existence wilder than life, death that conquers death, change that transcends immortality.
